name: text-field
description: A single-line text input with a visible label, optional hint, and inline error. For several lines use textarea.

name.description: Form field name. Also the default id.

hint.description: Help text shown under the label and linked with aria-describedby.

error.description: Validation message. Sets aria-invalid and is linked with aria-describedby.

autocomplete.description: HTML autocomplete token such as name or email (1.3.5).

keyboard.does: moves focus to and from the field

wcag.notes: Label is always visible and programmatically linked. Required is stated in text, not only with an asterisk. Errors are text next to the field (3.3.1) and the field keeps its value on error (3.3.7).

machine.identify: The accessible name is the label text. name is the form field name.
machine.operate: Focus the input and type. Read aria-invalid and the linked error text to learn about validation problems.

props.label: Email
props.name: email
props.error: Enter an email address like name@example.com.
